danger.deleteHint: Removes the workspace for everyone and stops its billing.
danger.deleteDescription: Everyone loses its projects, tasks, decisions and uploads. Recordings and files people shared stay theirs, in their own Notes and File Manager. This can’t be undone.
danger.leaveHint: You can be invited back later; your seat frees up.
danger.leaveDescription: Meetings and files you shared leave with you and stay in your Notes and File Manager. Files you transferred to the workspace stay here. Tasks stay with the team; your open ones become unassigned.
